highlights.summary: The new facility will manufacture parts for offshore wind farms in Scottish waters and for overseas markets.

highlights.headline: EU provides €61 million in humanitarian aid amidst rapidly deteriorating situation in Ethiopia
highlights.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 28 Sep 2026 Amid fears of renewed conflict in Northern Ethiopia, the European Union is providing €61 million in humanitarian funding to help the most vulnerable people in Ethiopia affected by conflict, displacement, disease outbreaks and climate-related hazards, including the impact of El Niño.
